title: Ambient Weather Observation Temperature Leaderboard
dataSources: Weather-station observations (`ecowitt:obs`, `weatherflow:obs`), air-quality readings (`purpleair:aqi`, `airgradient:sensor`), soil-moisture/greenhouse sensors, aquarium controllers (`aquarium:sensor`).
app: Personal weather stations (Ecowitt/Ambient/Davis/WeatherFlow), air-quality sensors (PurpleAir/AirGradient), and aquarium/greenhouse/soil sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ambientweather:obs temp_c=*
| stats sum(temp_c) as total_value, avg(temp_c) as avg_value by station_id
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks station values by total and average temperature across Ambient Weather observation events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `temp_c` values for each Ambient Weather observation event and review total and average temperature by station.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total temperature.
grandmaExplanation: It reviews which station shows the biggest temperature numbers in your Ambient Weather observation data.
